## Engineering testing and inspection

AN-THAI states support for static load testing, high-strain dynamic pile testing, low-strain integrity testing, crosshole sonic logging (CSL), plate load testing, geotechnical investigation, material testing and structural/specialized testing. The final method, specialist scope, deliverables and reporting responsibility are agreed for each project.

## Testing equipment and instrumentation

AN-THAI supplies B2B testing equipment and instrumentation for pile integrity testing, high-strain/dynamic pile testing, CSL/ultrasonic testing, static load-test instrumentation, load cells/sensors/data acquisition, geotechnical field testing, and material/laboratory testing. It can coordinate setup, training, calibration and technical support within the quotation scope.

## Choosing a pile test

Choose the method from the engineering question and project requirement, not from the test name alone.

- Low-Strain Integrity Test: rapid reflected-wave screening of pile continuity; it does not by itself establish geotechnical bearing capacity.
- High-Strain Dynamic Test: impact-based force/velocity measurement with wave-equation analysis for dynamic response and capacity-related evidence.
- Static Load Test: controlled loading with direct load-settlement measurements; reaction system, instrumentation and safe working area must be prepared.

Before mobilization, provide project location, pile type and size, design/test load, quantity, drawings/specification, schedule, and site/reaction constraints. Project-specific standards, acceptance criteria, report scope and signatory requirements are confirmed from the actual contract/project documents before testing.
